blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An aviation security personnel lost his job for P5,000. Stating that integrity is non-negotiable in public office, the Supreme Court’s (SC) Second Division through Associate Justice Marvic M.V.F. Leonen said it did not find any reversible error on the part of the Court of Appeals in affirming the findings of the National Police Commission (Napolcom) that found the officer guilty of grave misconduct causing his dismissal from service. “Corruption and extortion have no place in public service. This Court will not tolerate corrupt practices by public officers and will not hesitate to impose the necessary penalties to ensure […]...
